description: WHAT: The seven public HTML locales. RETURNS locales[] {id, name, prefix}. prefix is '' for de and '/en' '/fr' '/ru' '/fa' '/ar' '/tr' for others. Host is always www.ikeytz.com (apex redirects). maps.ikeytz.com has NO locales (/en/pattonville = 404). USE before resolve_locale_url. Call with {}.

inputSchema.description: This tool takes no arguments. Call tools/call with arguments: {}. Extra keys are ignored. Result is always the same public href (tel/mailto) or locale list.

name: list_locales
title: List Locales
